text:
I got a nose job here last month. The salesperson was an older-looking woman who wanted a fuller nose. I booked for 9900 baht, but when I got there, it was 65,000 baht. When I said I wasn't interested, they said if I didn't do it, the bridge wouldn't be as prominent and the tip wouldn't be as pointed. They only mentioned disadvantages.
The aftercare wasn't good either.

restaurant_name: กรวินคลินิก สาขาเชียงใหม่
text: I've been doing it for three months now and I really like it. The staff are very knowledgeable about which ones are suitable and which ones solve my problems. I personally like this place.

restaurant_name: กรวินคลินิก สาขาเชียงใหม่
text: I booked a nose revision package, and the staff gave me excellent advice. The result is beautiful; I'm very happy with it.

restaurant_name: กรวินคลินิก สาขาเชียงใหม่
text: The procedure cost 4,900 baht. The doctor emphasized safety, a natural look, and core tightening. I like it.

restaurant_name: กรวินคลินิก สาขาเชียงใหม่
text: I had my lips done here and I really like it. I feel more confident now.

restaurant_name: กรวินคลินิก สาขาเชียงใหม่
text: Before the procedure, the staff responded to chats very quickly, but after the procedure, the after-sales service was terrible. When I contacted them to inquire about problems with my nose, the staff ignored my messages and didn't respond, and the problem resolution was extremely slow.
